title: Environment pinned layout
description: The shared workspace layout of an environment: which twin and map views are pinned. It names twins and maps by uuid and grants no control. Written by PUT /environments/{uuid}/pinned-layout. Rules kept in Python: each twinItems key equals its views' twinUuid, twins and maps belong to the environment, routeId is a manual control route, sensorId applies to camera views and routeId to route views, views are not repeated.

version.description: Version of the layout. An enum, not a const: a stored layout of another version is reported, not refused, so the shared-layout remove can still answer it with its own 409.

twinItems.description: Views for one twin, keyed by twin uuid. Omitted when empty; an empty list hides every view of that twin.
